title: Keto Christmas Spice Cupcakes
shortDescription: Warm spiced keto cupcakes with almond and coconut flour, ready in 43 minutes total.
description: These keto Christmas spice cupcakes taste like a holiday cookie in cupcake form. I built the base with almond flour and coconut flour, so they stay moist without any grain flour or added sugar.
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted and cooled
8 oz cream cheese, softened, for frosting
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened, for frosting
instructions: Preheat your oven to 325°F. Line a 12 cup muffin pan with paper liners.
In a large bowl, whisk almond flour, coconut flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, ginger, cloves and nutmeg.
In a separate bowl, whisk eggs, melted butter, heavy cream, vanilla and erythritol until smooth.
Pour the wet mix into the dry mix. Stir just until no dry streaks remain.
Let the batter rest 5 minutes. Coconut flour needs time to soak up the liquid.
Divide batter evenly among the 12 liners, filling each about two thirds full.
Bake 16 to 18 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean and tops spring back.
Cool cupcakes in the pan 10 minutes, then move to a wire rack to cool fully.
Beat cream cheese and butter until smooth. Add powdered erythritol and cinnamon, then beat until fluffy.
Pipe or spread frosting on cooled cupcakes. Top with chopped pecans if you like extra crunch.
tips: Measure almond flour by spooning it into the cup and leveling off. Packed flour makes dense cupcakes.
Let cupcakes cool completely before frosting. Warm cupcakes will melt the cream cheese frosting.
Swap allulose for erythritol if you want a softer crumb with less cooling aftertaste.
Store leftovers in the fridge in a sealed container for up to 5 days.

faq.question: Can I make these keto Christmas spice cupcakes dairy free?
faq.answer: Yes. Swap the butter for coconut oil and use full fat coconut cream instead of heavy cream. The frosting works with dairy free cream cheese too.

faq.question: Why did my cupcakes sink in the middle?
faq.answer: This usually means the batter was underbaked or the oven door opened too early. Bake until a toothpick comes out clean and the tops feel firm to the touch.

faq.question: Can I use almond flour only, without coconut flour?
faq.answer: You can, but add another 1/4 cup almond flour to replace the coconut flour, since coconut flour absorbs much more liquid.

faq.question: How many net carbs are in one cupcake?
faq.answer: Each frosted cupcake has about 4 grams net carbs. Based on erythritol and allulose which do not raise blood sugar for most people.

conclusion: These cupcakes bring holiday spice to your keto table without any sugar crash. Bake a batch for your next family gathering and watch them disappear fast.
